title: Your story title
logline: One sentence: main character + goal + obstacle.
story:
Beginning: set up the character and world.
Middle: show the challenge and a meaningful choice.
Ending: resolve the story and leave an emotional beat.
characters: Name — age range, silhouette, face/hair, clothing, colours, personality, voice/language/pronunciation.
palette: Midnight blue, warm amber, paper ivory
voice_plan: Narrator: language, age range, tone, pace, pronunciation. Characters: name, voice description, dialogue style.
music_notes: Mood, instruments, energy, where music starts/stops; note any silence.

scenes.title: Opening image
scenes.action: Describe setting, action, movement and important props.
scenes.narration: Exact narrator words for this scene.
scenes.dialogue: Character name: exact spoken line, or empty string.
scenes.sound: Ambience, sound effect, music cue and purposeful silence.

scenes.title: The choice
scenes.action: What changes? Describe the character's action and reaction.
scenes.dialogue: Character name: exact words, or empty string.
scenes.sound: Ambience, music change, effect cue and silence.

scenes.title: The payoff
scenes.action: Show the outcome, emotional payoff and final visual beat.
scenes.dialogue: Character name: exact words, or empty string.
scenes.sound: Music resolution, ambience, effects and final quiet beat.
